BiblicalUsage: Chophaph is to cover in protection, and it stands once in the blessing of Benjamin. The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by Him, and He shall cover him all the day long, and dwell between his shoulders, a single word for a lifetime of shelter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the covering in this verse is the promise I lean on, because God covers His beloved all the day long.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
